title: CobbleJourneys
body:
![Big Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9fd9e778f8c3da88f4ef26efab00090d8dffbd91.png)

Embark on an unforgettable adventure in CobbleJourneys, a carefully crafted Cobblemon modpack that blends Pokémon exploration, training, and battles with the limitless creativity of Minecraft.

Travel across breathtaking landscapes, discover hidden structures, encounter trainers, complete research tasks, and build your dream team as you explore a world filled with adventure. Whether your goal is to complete the Pokédex, become a powerful trainer, or simply explore the unknown, your journey starts here.

# ✨ Features
## 🎮 Expanded Cobblemon Experience
Catch, train, and battle hundreds of Pokémon.
Complete Research Tasks and track your progress.
Enhanced Pokédex, Wiki, and navigation tools.
Additional content including Mega Evolution and other unique battle features.
## ⚔️ Trainers & Challenges
Battle trainers found throughout the world.
Discover legendary monuments and unique structures.
Test your skills against increasingly difficult encounters.
## 🌎 Exploration Without Limits
Explore a stunning world generated with Tectonic.
Travel across land, sea, and sky using Pokémon mounts.
Find rare Pokémon, hidden locations, and exciting adventures around every corner.
## 🏡 Build Your Own Story
Hundreds of decorative blocks and furniture options.
Create your own home, laboratory, Pokémon Center, or Gym.
Shape the world around you and make it truly yours.
## ⚡ Optimized Performance
Includes performance-enhancing mods for a smooth experience.
Shader support through Iris.
Designed for both singleplayer and multiplayer gameplay.
## 🎯 Your Journey Awaits

The world is full of Pokémon to discover, trainers to challenge, and stories to create. Every route leads to new adventures, every battle brings new opportunities, and every capture brings you one step closer to completing your Pokédex.

Gather your team, explore the unknown, and begin your adventure in CobbleJourneys.

"Every great journey starts with a single Poké Ball." ⚡🌎🎒🐾
